cohort: 20853 women giving birth at the department of obstetrics and gynecology, Seth G.S. Medical College and K.E.M. Hospital, a large tertiary care municipal hospital in Western India between January 1 and December 31 in 2001, 2006, and 2011
finding: The cesarean delivery rate increased from 171.70 to 289.30 per 1,000 live births, with an increase in primary cesarean delivery rate from 118.53 (69.03 %) in 2001 to 210.09 (72.62 %) in 2011 per 1,000 live births, and fetal distress, arrest of descent, multiple gestations, and fetal indications contributed to this increase.
